Description: Unattended cooking equipment in the staff kitchen could cause fire and evacuation.
Controls and mitigation: Fire blankets installed; monthly extinguisher checks; clear kitchen policy posted.

Description: Portable devices left unattended overnight increase theft and data-loss risk.
Controls and mitigation: Cable locks issued; end-of-day clear-desk reminder; encrypted disks enforced.

Description: Delayed AV updates may leave endpoints exposed to known malware.
Controls and mitigation: Centralised patch window every Tuesday; SOC alert on signature lag > 48h.

Description: Extended overtime during audit season may increase human error in clinical recording.
Controls and mitigation: Rotas capped at contracted hours; buddy checks on critical entries.

Description: Ground-floor archive is below flood datum; water ingress could destroy paper records.
Controls and mitigation: Records elevated on racking; dehumidifier monitored; digital scan backlog prioritised.

Description: Incomplete shift handovers may delay escalation of deteriorating patients.
Controls and mitigation: Structured SBAR checklist mandatory; random sample audit weekly.

Description: Critical vendor contracts may lapse without renewal, leading to service interruption.
Controls and mitigation: Contract calendar with 90/60/30 day reminders; dual owner on renewals.
Acceptance rationale: Accepted residual risk while calendar is rolled out org-wide

Risk title: Shared admin password on wifi router
Description: Default or shared credentials on office wifi increase unauthorised access risk.
Controls and mitigation: Unique admin password rotated quarterly; guest network segregated.
